In the organizational scheme of the Abhidhamma, it represents an analytical section coupling the dyad on conditions or root causes (*hetuduka*) with the triad concerning clinging or grasped phenomena (*upādinnattika*) [SuttaCentral].
No curated cross-language parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan are recorded for this text, and automated cross-language searches report no significant alignments [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
